source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_SELECT_SRC
(
                UserID,
                UserName,
                UserRole,
                UserEmail,
                BranchCode,
                PCCCode,
                BankCode,
                SourceSystemCode,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                UserID,
                UserName,
                UserRole,
                UserEmail,
                BranchCode,
                PCCCode,
                BankCode,
                SourceSystemCode,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_SELECT_SRC
(
                UserID,
                UserName,
                UserRole,
                UserEmail,
                BranchCode,
                PCCCode,
                BankCode,
                SourceSystemCode,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.UserID,
                CC.UserName,
                CC.UserRole,
                CC.UserEmail,
                CC.BranchCode,
                CC.PCCCode,
                CC.BankCode,
                CC.SourceSystemCode,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.DID_USERACCESSMATRIX CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX] B
            ON CC.UserEmail = B.UserEmail
            AND CC.BankCode = B.BankCode
            AND CC.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
            AND CC.BranchCode = B.BranchCode
            AND CC.PCCCode = B.PCCCode
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_GROUP_SRC
(
                UserID,
                UserName,
                UserRole,
                UserEmail,
                BranchCode,
                PCCCode,
                BankCode,
                SourceSystemCode,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                UserID,
                UserName,
                UserRole,
                UserEmail,
                BranchCode,
                PCCCode,
                BankCode,
                SourceSystemCode,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                UserID,
                UserName,
                UserRole,
                UserEmail,
                BranchCode,
                PCCCode,
                BankCode,
                SourceSystemCode,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                UserID,
                UserName,
                UserRole,
                UserEmail,
                BranchCode,
                PCCCode,
                BankCode,
                SourceSystemCode
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.DID_USERACCESSMATRIX A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.UserEmail,'-1') = COALESCE(B.UserEmail,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BankCode,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BankCode,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SourceSystemCode,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SourceSystemCode,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BranchCode,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BranchCode,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.PCCCode,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PCCCode,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.DID_USERACCESSMATRIX
(
                UserID,
                UserName,
                UserRole,
                UserEmail,
                BranchCode,
                PCCCode,
                BankCode,
                SourceSystemCode,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.UserID,
                SRC.UserName,
                SRC.UserRole,
                SRC.UserEmail,
                SRC.BranchCode,
                SRC.PCCCode,
                SRC.BankCode,
                SRC.SourceSystemCode,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'DID',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
